evidence_type: Author feedback and one supplied ModelViewer screenshot
screenshot_observations: The broad site surface is present and appears continuous in the supplied overall view.
Roads and pad boundaries remain visually distinguishable.
No obvious terrain breakthrough is visible in this frame.
conclusion: Positive author feedback on the 3 cm ground-clearance candidate. Adopt this ground treatment for the next assembly revision, keeping buildings, roads and pads at their original heights.
limits: The author supplied a general positive result rather than separate answers for flicker, grass breakthrough and road edges.
A single still image does not independently establish temporal stability or every camera and lighting condition.
The exact renderer mechanism remains unproven; gameplay terrain and a playable mod have not been tested.

decision.accepted_scope: Working ground-surface treatment for the next assembly revision
decision.assembly_source_integration: Next step; original A04 baseline and current diagnostic artifacts remain unchanged.
next_steps: Apply the accepted ground-top height consistently to the editable site source and native assembly in a new revision.
Preserve the original baseline and the successful 07 and 08 diagnostic references.
Verify and publish the revised Blender source and native model before any further manual review.
